access.development_view: Before method freeze, provide exactly permitted TRAIN/VALID materials, task/paper and access-specific official code/assets; exclude TEST eval_input_20ms.h5 and all other test observations.
excluded_materials: Unprovided external models/assets or artifacts with unknown source; the official allowlist governs released author assets, not new candidate artifacts derived from admitted TRAIN/VALID materials
New raw fields or extra trials
access.source_method_dependencies: This improvement condition does not impose the SMC causal/noncausal source-method recipe. Faithful SMC reproduction and the strict local trial-independent condition remain separately bound routes.
access.test: After method freeze, all 574 original test trials, each with all 35 supplied held-in bins and 137 held-in neurons, are jointly available. Original test held-out spikes, all ten future bins and test behavior remain evaluator-only.
access.training_validation: Exactly the admitted original training/validation tensors and supplied original validation targets in each participant inventory.

adaptation_reporting.condition_is_not_actual_use: Report the selected full-panel access condition even if a participant does not use all allowed observations. Do not infer that adaptation occurred merely because access was permitted.
adaptation_reporting.official_asset_actions: For paper_data, no official-code/released-asset usage is allowed. In the assisted condition, actual load/adapt/fine_tune/retrain/replace actions must remain within the frozen plan and exact allowlist.
adaptation_reporting.parameter_flag_scope: parameter_adaptation_planned/performed concerns learned-parameter updates; it does not by itself describe every cross-trial computation.
adaptation_reporting.required_actual_description: Describe actual panel coupling, sufficient-statistic calculation and learned-parameter changes, including a statement when no adaptation occurred. Distinguish planned method from performed use.

authoring_resources.requirement: Before an actual episode, predeclare a separate matched authoring/development resource policy and retain actual resource records and custody evidence. Do not fabricate these from the later execution cgroup.

claim_limits: Fixed-panel transductive comparison; no fresh-trial or inductive generalization claim
No faithful SMC reproduction claim for this improvement route
No original 5-ms NLB competition or leaderboard claim
No binary scientific improvement pass, meaningful superiority or equivalence claim
No biological generalization, causal-online claim or untouched holdout claim
No current SOTA, novelty or temporal-completeness claim
Code-plus-weights access effect does not isolate code alone
Released-model assistance does not establish independent training or native neural understanding

required: Qualified participant/runtime custody and resource enforcement
Separate actual submission and scientific evidence for outcome claims

estimand: The unchanged four original evaluator measurements on the complete fixed MC_Maze 20-ms panel, conditional on one committed full-panel offline prediction set. The selected access condition permits cross-test-trial inference and declared adaptation to supplied unlabeled held-in observations.

later_literature_context.attribution: Existing reviewed calibration report cites authors' 2026-03-10 Table1 MC_Maze20ms; no new literature retrieval or local evaluation.
later_literature_context.name: LangevinFlow

later_literature_context.attribution: Reported by LangevinFlow in existing reviewed calibration report; not independently sourced from original MINT publication.
later_literature_context.name: MINT

material_identity.input_reuse: Authenticated unchanged original source input bytes may be reused in a fresh export. Recompute the actual inventory and pair digest; do not assume the earlier 71-file count or task/policy identity applies.

method_freeze.authoring_evidence: Authenticate the TRAIN/VALID-only development view and its relation to the frozen method. A later file hash alone does not prove that an earlier authoring agent was blind to test inputs.
bound_items: selected allowed official asset identities and planned actions
method_freeze.candidate_artifact_provenance: Selected new candidate artifacts must be derived from admitted development materials under the declared authoring policy and bound before test release. Official released author assets remain restricted to the assisted condition and exact allowlist; no unprovided external data or unknown-source model is added.
method_freeze.distinction: Freeze the algorithm, program, selected artifacts, seeds and adaptation procedure before test-input exposure. Learned parameters may change under that frozen procedure. Cross-trial inference or sufficient statistics can use the panel without necessarily changing learned parameters.
method_freeze.exposure_scope: The first test-input release within the admitted episode. This boundary does not prove that pretrained models or participants never encountered publicly available data in their history.

official_assets.declaration_requirement: Declare actual per-asset loading, adaptation, fine-tuning, retraining and replacement for every method. Declarations are not authenticated execution evidence.
historical_limits: Exact historical training inputs and seeds are not proven
Exact checkpoint-to-printed-row identity is not proven
Undocumented upstream training/selection exposure is not ruled out
Training-history pickles are public source artifacts, not asserted pure weights
The publicly exposed original test panel is not an untouched holdout
official_assets.loading_boundary: The original loader uses unrestricted serialization. Future loading belongs only in an isolated participant or separately admitted author-model process, without operator test targets, credentials or writable trusted evaluator state. Hash authentication is not proof of safe execution. Prepare, inspect, freeze and score do not deserialize assets.
official_assets.reproduction_interpretation: Faithful released-model inference is assessed separately under the preserved source-method reproduction route; this full-panel improvement route does not establish reproduction.
official_assets.resource_limits: The matched improvement profile is 7200 CPU-seconds, 10800 wall-seconds, 8 GiB and six threads per access condition. It does not establish adequate independent-training resources or equal compute requirements.
official_assets.trusted_scorer: Only numerical HDF5 predictions are scored. No original or candidate checkpoint is deserialized by prepare, inspect, freeze or score.

improvement.companion_rule: Report all companion differences and negative differences as tradeoffs; no invented non-regression margin.
improvement.measurement: One complete original offline four-metric vector and signed differences from every retained SMC reference and each separate published source-paper comparison vector. Positive co-bps differences are descriptive ordering, not binary scientific wins.
improvement.reference_selection: Maximum co-bps among both published SMC and both current-release SMC references; retain the complete associated vector and every other reference.

provenance.relation: Additive inference condition for the same registered paper task; predecessor identity and evidence remain unchanged and do not qualify this successor.

scientific_basis.role: Original NLB method flexibility within supplied observations; not permission for extra data or target feedback
SMC paper-specific 20-ms task and fixed-model source reproduction recipe
Inspected historical official challenge rules; not exhaustive historical EvalAI recovery

reference_evidence.noncausal_completed_scalar_output: Separately authenticated and accepted without rerun; failed supervisor history remains failed.
reference_evidence.role: Current-release diagnostic references, not AI attempts or proof of exact historical reconstruction.

resource_profile.accounting_scope: One cumulative in-run execution budget per access condition, including training and adaptation performed in that execution. Do not reset it across iterations. The existing two-phase cgroup does not account for earlier authoring or development training outside its lifetime.
resource_profile.interpretation: An engineering access/resource setting, not proof of equal compute need or adequate independent-training resources.

uncertainty.published_rounding: Retain printed values; display precision is not an equivalence margin.
